csv_scope_of_work: The Central Puget Sound Regional Transit Authority (Sound Transit) is requesting a Statement of Qualifications and Proposed Approach (SOQ) from qualified proposers to provide Heavy Civil General Contractor/Construction Manager (HC-GC/CM) Services for the construction of the BT306 Lake Forest Park SR 522 (Bothell Way NE) Roadway & Station Improvements ( Project ) contract.
